title: Alpine Interface Options
doc: Menu options for a total conversion mod, read by Alpine Faction only when a mod is loaded.

alpine.notes: Alpine reads this file line by line, not with the game's table parser: lines are trimmed, everything before a line that is exactly #Start is ignored, reading stops at a line that is exactly #End, blank lines and lines starting with // are skipped, and every other line is 'name: value' split at the first colon. Field order does not matter, a later line overrides an earlier one, and unknown names are only logged. Comments after a value become part of the value.

sections.name: #Start
sections.doc: Options between #Start and #End, in any order.

fields.name: $Disable Multiplayer Button:
fields.doc: Hide the main menu Multiplayer button. 1, true or True mean yes; anything else means no.

fields.name: $Disable Singleplayer Buttons:
fields.doc: Hide New Game, Load and Save. 1, true or True mean yes; anything else means no.

fields.name: $Summoner Trailer Button Action:
fields.doc: What the Extras trailer button does: 1 open URL, 2 disable, 3 remove, 4 load level, other plays a video.

fields.name: +Summoner Trailer Button Bink Filename:
fields.doc: Video played by the default action.
